testInfo.summary: The client is expected to retrieve OpenID Provider Configuration Information from the .well-known/openid-configuration endpoint and detect that the issuer in the provider configuration does not match the Issuer URL that was used as the prefix to /.well-known/openid-configuration to retrieve the configuration information. As per OpenID Connect Discovery Section 4.3 the client is expected to stop the flow.
